crossRefs.note: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be…
Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

translations.web: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
translations.bsb: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
translations.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
translations.asv: Let thy meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.
